proposals.hypothesis: All user journeys (browse, cart, checkout) will be broken. Expected: 100% error rate for frontend requests. Graceful behavior: The system should not have any user traffic.
proposals.reason: Frontend is the entrypoint for all user journeys (browse, cart, checkout) and is critical (critical: true). This experiment reveals the highest real user impact as it affects all user flows. It has not been run previously.

proposals.hypothesis: Only the checkout journey will be degraded. Expected: High error rate for checkout journey at the shippingservice step. Graceful behavior: The system should allow the user to proceed without shipping (if the service is optional) but the role indicates it is critical for mock shipment.
proposals.reason: Shipping service is critical (critical: true) and appears in the checkout journey (the most important user journey for completing a purchase). This experiment reveals high real user impact for the checkout flow. It has not been run previously.

proposals.hypothesis: Only the checkout journey will be degraded. Expected: High error rate for checkout journey at the paymentservice step. Graceful behavior: The system should allow the user to retry the payment.
proposals.reason: Payment service is critical (critical: true) and appears in the checkout journey. This experiment reveals critical real user impact for the checkout flow. It has not been run previously.
